<b>Driznargas</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are large male [[Driznit|Driznits]].<ref>Driznarga [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Large male Driznit, ferocious and territorial."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Driznargas behave very similiarly to [[Driznit]]s, burrowing out of ceilings when Hornet gets near and firing off their coral-fused masks.<br>
Being ranged flying enemies, Driznargas always try to maintain distance between themselves and Hornet, but especially prioritising vertical distance. They are, however, slower than Driznits and have a larger hitbox.<br>
To attack, Driznargas fire off their coral masks at a diagonal angle, which ricochet off of surfaces up to 7 times before breaking. If Hornet is hit by the projectile, it drills into her and combos her for {{Damage|1+1}}. Hornet's attacks can change the spike's direction and cause it to hit itself or other enemies for 15 damage. The spike can only damage enemies if Hornet has hit it.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Driznargas have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* The crust covers...
* The crust conceals...
* Our shells made strong...
* Our nest made secret...
}}

== Location ==
Driznargas can be found primarily in the [[Sands of Karak]], but one also appears in the [[Memorium]], and another spawns alongside a [[Void Mass]] during [[Act 3]] in the [[Blasted Steps]], disappearing once the mass is destroyed.
